Funded by the UK’s national innovation agency InnovateUK and Network Rail, the AVA Bridge project was delivered by a consortium. Its members include Walker Construction who are leading and managing the project. They are overseeing other members including construction contractor McNealy Brown, as well as input from the Manufacturing Technology Centre (MTC), an independent research and technology organization.
